follow-up time: Median follow-up time ranged from 6.1 to 22.6 months, depending on surgical route
exposure: Different surgical routes (vaginal, laparoscopic, robotic-assisted laparoscopic, abdominal)
cohort: 240 women who underwent uterine-sparing prolapse procedures between January 2003 and December 2011
finding: Uterine-sparing prolapse procedures appear to have good long-term safety and a low risk of future gynecologic pathology, with similar prolapse recurrence and complication rates across different surgical routes.
